def _parse_ruby_link(inline: 'InlineParser', state: 'InlineState', pos: int,
    tokens: List[Dict[str, Any]]) ->Optional[int]:
    src = state.src
    c = src[pos]

    if c == '(':
        # inline link: [ruby](/url "title")
        new_pos, attrs = parse_link(src, pos)
        if new_pos:
            children = list(tokens)
            state.append_token({
                'type': 'link',
                'children': children,
                'attrs': attrs,
            })
            return new_pos

    elif c == '[':
        # reference link: [ruby][label]
        new_pos, label = parse_link_label(src, pos + 1)
        if new_pos:
            key = unikey(label)
            attrs = state.get_link(key)
            if attrs:
                children = list(tokens)
                state.append_token({
                    'type': 'link',
                    'children': children,
                    'attrs': attrs,
                })
                return new_pos

    return None
